claims: Philadelphia Union defeated CF Montréal 2-1 on April 11, 2026
The win marked Philadelphia Union's first win of the MLS season
Iván Jaime opened the scoring for CF Montréal
Japhet Sery Larsen scored for Philadelphia Union
Jesús Bueno scored for Philadelphia Union
A 13th-minute penalty for CF Montréal was overturned by VAR
The VAR review confirmed keeper Andre Blake got a touch on the ball
The win broke Philadelphia Union's winless streak to start the 2026 season
